_provenance: MinSizeRel-only budgets from in-house OSS CMake/clang isolated-TU runs (SAI_BRCM_IMPL 15.4.0.0_odp + sai 1.18.1). VmPeak here is VSZ, capped by a 30 GiB RLIMIT_AS on the measuring job. measured_gib is the worst observed peak; vmpeak_gib adds 10% headroom for first sightings, existing ceilings never move. Budgets do not cover other build types: ServiceHandler RelWithDebInfo measured 17.13 GiB, sized instead by the 22 GiB per-TU assumption feeding pool depth in fsdb_pool.py. Add TUs only with measured peaks via check --update-budgets; never invent numbers.
